_comment: Sanitized REAL capture of the Helm project's Linear issue blocking graph as returned by the linear MCP on 2026-10-09 (get_issue includeRelations). Trimmed to fields the readiness/preflight logic (EGA-680/F3, EGA-681/F4) must consume. Identifiers/titles match doc/ISSUES.md. No secrets, no personal data. statusType is the readiness-critical field: only a blocker whose statusType === 'completed' counts as resolved; 'canceled' or unreadable/unstarted/backlog/started blockers all block launch.

readiness_note: Blocking direction is authoritative: an issue is READY only when every blockedBy edge references a node whose statusType === 'completed'. EGA-676 is now completed so EGA-677 becomes eligible, but EGA-677's *work* is separately gated on hosted-access provisioning (see integration-gate.md). The canceled/unreadable/unstarted cases are enforced in EGA-680 unit fixtures.
